mines.mine_notes: Underhand cut-and-fill underground (H-Vein primary) in Murray Gold Belt, Shoshone County, Idaho. 41,840 t processed @ 10.14 g/t flotation feed grade, 93% recovery; 12,538 oz contained in concentrates + dore; 11,834 payable oz sold. Ore processed at the New Jersey Mill (JV, 65% of assets/3,000 t/month) and Murray Mill. Record 19,162 m drilling in 2025; Paymaster conversion drove 53.2% reserve growth. 2% NSR royalty (Calibre Mining). Revenue $42.4M; net income $16.7M; 3rd consecutive GAAP-profitable year. AISC incl. exploration; adjusted ex-exploration AISC $1,494.75/oz. CEO/President John Swallow.
mines.processing: Flotation mill (New Jersey Mill) producing gold concentrate + dore

notes: FY2025 Form 10-K filed March 23, 2026. Single producing mine (Golden Chest). Record 2025: revenue +64.6% to $42.4M, net income $16.7M ($1.14 diluted EPS), P&P reserves +53.2%.
